blocks.text: Smart contracts aise digital agreements (samjhaute) hain jo khaas conditions (shartein) poori hone par un mein likhi shartein khud ba khud poori kar dete hain. Yeh contracts blockchain technology par chalte hain, is liye intermediaries (beech wale) ki zaroorat khatam ho jati hai aur ghalti aur dhoke ka khatra kam hota hai.

Ethereum jaise platforms developers ko smart contracts se decentralized applications (DApps) banane dete hain. Yeh contracts bohat se fields mein kaam aate hain, jaise finance, supply chain management, real estate (jaidad) aur insurance (beema). Maslan insurance ka smart contract pehle se tay conditions ke mutabiq flight late hone par khud ba khud raqam ada kar sakta hai.

Smart contracts ke faide: transparency (sab kuch sab ko saaf nazar aana), kyunke sab log contract ki shartein dekh sakte hain; aur security, kyunke contract ka chalna blockchain yaqeeni banata hai. Lekin in ke kuch masail bhi hain, jaise code bilkul be-ghalti hona chahiye, aur in contracts ke jhagron ko hal karne ke liye legal systems (qanoon aur adalat ka system) bhi chahiye.

blocks.prompt: Blockchain 2.0 ke hawale se smart contract kya hai (exercise MCQ 18)? Blockchain 2.0 mein smart contracts kya hain (exercise short question 5)?
blocks.explanation: (b) Aisa khud chalne wala (self-executing) contract jis ki shartein seedhi code mein likhi hoti hain. Jab code mein likhi conditions poori hon, maslan payment mil jaye aur ownership (malik hona) ki verification (jaanch kar pakka karna) ho jaye, to contract kisi intermediary ke baghair khud chal jata hai.

items: Smart contracts: blockchain par khud chalne wale digital agreements.
Ethereum par DApps; finance, supply chain, real estate, insurance (flight late ki misal).
Faide: transparency, security; masail: be-ghalti code aur qanooni system ki zaroorat.
